<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Story Learning Lab - Plot Mountain</title>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/html2pdf.js/0.10.1/html2pdf.bundle.min.js"></script>
<style>
/* ===================== App UI (all rules scoped to .sll-app) ===================== */
.sll-app, .sll-app * { box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
.sll-app {
  --blue: #2b5b84; --blue-dark: #1f4666; --blue-soft: #eaf1f8;
  --amber: #f5a623; --amber-dark: #d98d0b;
  --ink: #1f2d3a; --muted: #5d6f80; --line: #d9e4ee; --bg: #f1f6fa;
  font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--bg);
  padding: 24px 16px 40px;
  line-height: 1.4;
}
.sll-wrap { max-width: 1080px; margin: 0 auto; }

.sll-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; margin-bottom: 22px; }
.sll-mark { width: 46px; height: 46px; flex: none; border-radius: 13px; background: var(--blue); display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--amber); font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.1rem; }
.sll-app .sll-title-main { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: inherit; font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: normal; text-transform: none; color: var(--blue); }
.sll-app .sll-tagline { margin: 3px 0 0; font-size: .95rem; color: var(--muted); }

.sll-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(300px, 380px) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 22px; align-items: start; }
@media (max-width: 860px) { .sll-layout { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } }

.sll-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 18px; box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(31, 70, 102, .07); }
.sll-controls { padding: 4px 18px 18px; }
.sll-field { padding: 15px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.sll-field.sll-last { border-bottom: 0; }
.sll-label { display: block; margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--blue); }
.sll-sublabel { display: block; margin: 12px 0 6px; font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted); }
.sll-hint { margin: 7px 0 0; font-size: .8rem; color: var(--muted); }
.sll-hint.sll-bad { color: #b3261e; font-weight: 600; }

.sll-app input[type="text"], .sll-app textarea, .sll-app select {
  width: 100%; margin: 0; padding: 10px 12px;
  border: 1px solid #c5d3df; border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink);
  font: inherit; font-size: .95rem;
}
.sll-app textarea { min-height: 150px; resize: vertical; line-height: 1.5; }
.sll-app input + textarea { margin-top: 8px; }
.sll-app button { font: inherit; }
.sll-app input:focus-visible, .sll-app textarea:focus-visible, .sll-app button:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid rgba(74, 144, 226, .5); outline-offset: 1px;
}

.sll-seg { display: grid; grid-auto-flow: column; grid-auto-columns: 1fr; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; background: var(--blue-soft); border-radius: 12px; }
.sll-seg button { min-height: 42px; padding: 8px 4px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: var(--blue); font-size: .92rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; }
.sll-seg button:hover { background: rgba(43, 91, 132, .08); }
.sll-seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--blue); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(31, 70, 102, .35); }

.sll-step-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.sll-step-name { font-weight: 600; font-size: .95rem; }
.sll-step-name small { display: block; font-weight: 400; font-size: .78rem; color: var(--muted); }
.sll-step { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.sll-step button { flex: none; width: 42px; height: 42px; padding: 0; border: 2px solid var(--blue); border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; color: var(--blue); font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; }
.sll-step button:hover { background: var(--blue-soft); }
.sll-step output { min-width: 34px; text-align: center; font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--blue); }

.sll-actions { display: grid; gap: 10px; padding-top: 16px; }
.sll-btn { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .08s ease; }
.sll-btn:active { transform: translateY(2px); }
.sll-btn[disabled] { opacity: .6; cursor: wait; }
.sll-btn-primary { background: var(--amber); color: #2a1d00; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--amber-dark); }
.sll-btn-outline { background: #fff; color: var(--blue); border: 2px solid var(--blue); }
.sll-btn-small { width: auto; min-height: 40px; margin-top: 12px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: .9rem; }

.sll-preview { padding: 14px; min-width: 0; }
.sll-preview-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.sll-preview-title { font-weight: 700; color: var(--blue); }
.sll-switch { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 6px 4px; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; font-size: .92rem; cursor: pointer; }
.sll-switch-track { width: 44px; height: 26px; border-radius: 13px; background: #b9c8d6; position: relative; transition: background .15s; }
.sll-switch-track::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, .3); transition: transform .15s; }
.sll-switch[aria-checked="true"] .sll-switch-track { background: var(--blue); }
.sll-switch[aria-checked="true"] .sll-switch-track::after { transform: translateX(18px); }
#sll-notice { display: none; margin-bottom: 12px; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: .9rem; background: #fff6e5; border: 1px solid #f0c36b; color: #6b4300; }
#sll-notice.sll-error { background: #fdecec; border-color: #f0a3a3; color: #8a1f1f; }
.sll-stage { display: flex; justify-content: center; padding: 16px; border-radius: 12px; background: #e3ecf4; overflow: hidden; }
.sll-paper { position: relative; flex: none; background: #fff; border-radius: 2px; box-shadow: 0 8px 26px rgba(31, 70, 102, .2); overflow: hidden; }
.sll-paper-inner { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; transform-origin: top left; }
.sll-tip { margin: 12px 0 0; text-align: center; font-size: .85rem; color: var(--muted); }
#sll-cover { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 99999; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #fff; color: #2b5b84; font: 700 1.2rem 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; }



#sll-print-holder { display: none; }
@media print {
  html, body { margin: 0 !important; padding: 0 !important; background: #fff !important; }
  body > *:not(#sll-print-holder) { display: none !important; }
  #sll-print-holder { display: block !important; position: static !important; width: auto !important; }
  .pm-sheet { margin: 0 !important; }
}
/* ===================== Plot Mountain sheet ===================== */
.pm-sheet { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: #fff; color: #111; font-family: 'Arial', 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif; }
.pm-sheet * { box-sizing: border-box; }
.pm-logo { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 1.4%; transform: translateX(-50%); height: 44px; width: auto; }
.pm-title { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 5.5%; text-align: center; font-size: 30px; font-weight: 700; color: #2b5b84; }
.pm-box { position: absolute; border: 2px solid #222; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; padding: 8px 14px; }
.pm-hi { background: #fff04d; padding: 0 3px; border-radius: 3px; }
.pm-head { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 8px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; height: 30px; }
.pm-head span.pm-hl { flex: 1; border-bottom: 1.5px solid #222; height: 16px; }
.pm-lines { position: absolute; left: 14px; right: 14px; top: 42px; bottom: 6px; overflow: hidden; }
.pm-ln { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; height: 1px; background: #7b8590; }
.pm-label { position: absolute; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); border: 2px solid #222; border-radius: 14px; padding: 6px 18px; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; background: #fff; white-space: nowrap; }
.pm-tag { position: absolute; border: 2px solid #f5a623; background: #fff8e8; color: #7a4a00; border-radius: 12px; padding: 3px 10px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; }
.pm-trace { position: absolute; left: 14px; top: 44px; font-size: 22px; line-height: 22px; color: #9aa3ad; white-space: nowrap; }
.pm-art { position: absolute; left: 5%; top: 40%; width: 90%; height: auto; display: block; }
.pm-fig { position: absolute; transform: translate(-50%, -100%); }
.pm-fig svg { display: block; width: 46px; height: 69px; }
.pm-foot { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 1.4%; text-align: center; font-size: 12.5px; color: #555; }
</style>
</head>
<body style="margin:0">
<div class="sll-app">
  <div class="sll-wrap">
    <header class="sll-header">
      <div class="sll-mark" aria-hidden="true">Aa</div>
      <div>
        <h1 class="sll-title-main">Plot Mountain Worksheet</h1>
        <p class="sll-tagline">Story Learning Lab: plan a story with characters, setting, problem and the story steps</p>
      </div>
    </header>

    <div class="sll-layout">
      <section class="sll-card sll-controls" aria-label="Worksheet settings">
        <div class="sll-field">
          <label class="sll-label" for="sll-title">Worksheet title</label>
          <input type="text" id="sll-title" maxlength="50" value="Plot Mountain">
          <p class="sll-hint">The boxes and mountain labels stay the same. Students fill in their own story.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="sll-field">
          <span class="sll-label" id="sll-starters-label">Sentence starters on page 2</span>
          <div class="sll-seg" id="sll-starters" role="group" aria-labelledby="sll-starters-label">
            <button type="button" data-starters="show">Show</button>
            <button type="button" data-starters="hide">Hide</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="sll-field">
          <label class="sll-label" for="sll-st-b">Beginning starter (1. First)</label>
          <select id="sll-st-b" data-start="b"><option value="">None (blank line)</option><option value="Once upon a time,">Once upon a time,</option><option value="One day,">One day,</option><option value="In the morning,">In the morning,</option><option value="Long ago,">Long ago,</option></select>
          <label class="sll-label" for="sll-st-m">Middle starter (2. Next / 3. Then)</label>
          <select id="sll-st-m" data-start="m"><option value="">None (blank line)</option><option value="Suddenly,">Suddenly,</option><option value="Then,">Then,</option><option value="Next,">Next,</option><option value="After that,">After that,</option></select>
          <label class="sll-label" for="sll-st-e">End starter (4. Last)</label>
          <select id="sll-st-e" data-start="e"><option value="">None (blank line)</option><option value="In the end,">In the end,</option><option value="Finally,">Finally,</option><option value="From that day on,">From that day on,</option><option value="At last,">At last,</option></select>
          <p class="sll-hint">The chosen sentence is printed in light grey on the first writing line of each part.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="sll-field">
          <span class="sll-label" id="sll-page-label">Paper size</span>
          <div class="sll-seg" id="sll-page" role="group" aria-labelledby="sll-page-label">
            <button type="button" data-page="letter">Letter</button>
            <button type="button" data-page="a4">A4</button>
          </div>
          
          
          <span class="sll-sublabel" id="sll-foot-label">Story Learning Lab footer</span>
          <div class="sll-seg" id="sll-foot" role="group" aria-labelledby="sll-foot-label">
            <button type="button" data-foot="show">Show</button>
            <button type="button" data-foot="hide">Hide</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="sll-field sll-last">
          <span class="sll-label" id="sll-story-label">My Story writing page (page 2)</span>
          <div class="sll-seg" id="sll-story" role="group" aria-labelledby="sll-story-label">
            <button type="button" data-story="show">Include</button>
            <button type="button" data-story="hide">Leave out</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="sll-actions">
          <button type="button" class="sll-btn sll-btn-primary" id="sll-pdf">Download Worksheet PDF</button>
          <button type="button" class="sll-btn sll-btn-outline" id="sll-pdf2">Download My Story PDF</button>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section class="sll-card sll-preview" aria-label="Worksheet preview">
        <div class="sll-preview-bar">
          <span class="sll-preview-title">Worksheet preview</span>
        </div>
        <div class="sll-stage" id="sll-stage">
          <div id="sll-pages"></div>
        </div>
        <p class="sll-tip">Students write their story in each box. The climber shows the story going up the mountain, from First to Last.</p>
      </section>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var LOGO_SRC = "data:image/png;base64,";
  var PAGES = { letter: { w: 816, h: 1050, fmt: 'letter' }, a4: { w: 793, h: 1116, fmt: 'a4' } };
  var settings = { page: 'letter', logo: true, foot: true, story: true, starters: true, starts: { b: '', m: '', e: '' } };

  function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }
  function esc(s) { return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function (c) { return { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;' }[c]; }); }

  // Stick person climbing the slope (feet at the bottom of the figure)
  var CLIMBER = '<svg viewBox="0 0 40 60" aria-hidden="true"><g fill="none" stroke="#1f4666" stroke-width="3.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">' +
    '<circle cx="21" cy="9" r="7"/>' +
    '<line x1="20" y1="17" x2="18" y2="36"/>' +
    '<polyline points="19,23 28,16 34,10"/>' +
    '<polyline points="19,23 11,28 7,36"/>' +
    '<polyline points="18,36 27,43 29,54"/>' +
    '<polyline points="18,36 10,44 9,57"/></g></svg>';

  // Seeded random so the sketch looks the same every time it is drawn
  function rng(seed) {
    return function () {
      seed = (seed + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0;
      var t = Math.imul(seed ^ (seed >>> 15), 1 | seed);
      t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
      return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
    };
  }
  // Points along a curved (cubic) line, with a little hand-drawn wobble
  function curvePts(p, seed, wobble) {
    var r = rng(seed), pts = [], n = 30;
    for (var i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
      var t = i / n, u = 1 - t;
      var x = u * u * u * p[0][0] + 3 * u * u * t * p[1][0] + 3 * u * t * t * p[2][0] + t * t * t * p[3][0];
      var y = u * u * u * p[0][1] + 3 * u * u * t * p[1][1] + 3 * u * t * t * p[2][1] + t * t * t * p[3][1];
      var edge = (i === 0 || i === n);
      if (!edge) { x += (r() - 0.5) * 2 * wobble; y += (r() - 0.5) * 2 * wobble; }
      pts.push([x, y]);
    }
    return pts;
  }
  function polyEl(pts, width, opacity) {
    return '<polyline points="' + pts.map(function (q) { return q[0].toFixed(2) + ',' + q[1].toFixed(2); }).join(' ') +
      '" fill="none" stroke="#222" stroke-width="' + width + '" stroke-opacity="' + opacity + '" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"/>';
  }
  function shortStroke(x1, y1, x2, y2, width, seed) {
    return polyEl(curvePts([[x1, y1], [x1 + (x2 - x1) / 3, y1 + (y2 - y1) / 3], [x1 + 2 * (x2 - x1) / 3, y1 + 2 * (y2 - y1) / 3], [x2, y2]], seed, 0.03), width, 1);
  }
  function box(left, top, width, height, label, trace) {
    // writing lines as real elements, so they print in the PDF (extra lines are clipped)
    var lines = '<div class="pm-lines">';
    for (var k = 0; k < 12; k++) lines += '<div class="pm-ln" style="top:' + (27 + k * 28) + 'px"></div>';
    var st = (trace && settings.starters) ? '<div class="pm-trace">' + trace + '</div>' : '';
    return '<div class="pm-box" style="left:' + left + '%;top:' + top + '%;width:' + width + '%;height:' + height + '%">' +
      '<div class="pm-head"><span>' + label + '</span><span class="pm-hl"></span></div>' + st + lines + '</div></div>';
  }
  function label(left, top, text) {
    return '<div class="pm-label" style="left:' + left + '%;top:' + top + '%">' + esc(text) + '</div>';
  }
  function tag(left, top, text) {
    return '<div class="pm-tag" style="left:' + left + '%;top:' + top + '%">' + esc(text) + '</div>';
  }

  function sheetHTML(P, title) {
    return '<div class="pm-sheet" style="width:' + P.w + 'px;height:' + P.h + 'px">' +
      (settings.logo ? '<img class="pm-logo" src="' + LOGO_SRC + '" alt="">' : '') +
      '<div class="pm-title" style="top:' + (settings.logo ? '6.5%' : '3%') + '">' + esc(title) + '</div>' +
      // hand-drawn mountain (uploaded picture, climber included)
      '<img class="pm-art" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="">' +
      // four story boxes at the top
      box(3, 11, 35, 16, 'Characters (<span class="pm-hi">Who</span>):') +
      box(3, 29, 35, 16, 'Setting (<span class="pm-hi">Where / When</span>):') +
      box(62, 11, 35, 16, 'Problem (<span class="pm-hi">What / Why</span>):') +
      box(62, 29, 35, 16, 'Rising action:') +
      // climax and middle labels on the mountain
      label(50, 52, 'Middle') +
      // high point and resolution boxes
      box(33, 58, 34, 14, 'High point of action:') +
      box(33, 77, 34, 15, 'Resolution:') +
      // beginning and end
      label(12, 87, 'Beginning') +
      label(88, 87, 'End') +
      // sequence steps along the story
      tag(3, 64, '1. First') +
      tag(14, 52, '2. Next') +
      tag(70, 52, '3. Then') +
      tag(84, 62, '4. Last') +
      (settings.foot ? '<div class="pm-foot">Created with Story Learning Lab. Visit www.storylearninglab.com for more classroom resources.</div>' : '') +
      '</div>';
  }

  // Page 2: My Story writing page (picture box plus Beginning, Middle, End writing lines)
  function storyHTML(P) {
    return '<div class="pm-sheet" style="width:' + P.w + 'px;height:' + P.h + 'px">' +
      (settings.logo ? '<img class="pm-logo" src="' + LOGO_SRC + '" alt="">' : '') +
      '<div class="pm-title" style="top:' + (settings.logo ? '6.5%' : '3%') + '">My Story</div>' +
      box(3, 11, 94, 6.6, 'Title:') +
      '<div class="pm-box" style="left:3%;top:20%;width:94%;height:25%"></div>' +
      box(3, 46.5, 94, 13, 'Beginning (<span class="pm-hi">1. First</span>):', settings.starts.b) +
      box(3, 61, 94, 19, 'Middle (<span class="pm-hi">2. Next</span> and <span class="pm-hi">3. Then</span>):', settings.starts.m) +
      box(3, 81.5, 94, 13, 'End (<span class="pm-hi">4. Last</span>):', settings.starts.e) +
      (settings.foot ? '<div class="pm-foot">Created with Story Learning Lab. Visit www.storylearninglab.com for more classroom resources.</div>' : '') +
      '</div>';
  }

  function title() { return $('sll-title').value.trim() || 'Plot Mountain'; }

  function renderPreview() {
    var wrap = $('sll-pages'), P = PAGES[settings.page];
    var avail = $('sll-stage').clientWidth - 32;
    var scale = Math.max(0.2, Math.min(1, avail / P.w));
    wrap.innerHTML = '';
    var list = [sheetHTML(P, title())];
    if (settings.story) list.push(storyHTML(P));
    list.forEach(function (html, i) {
      var box = document.createElement('div');
      box.className = 'sll-paper';
      box.style.width = (P.w * scale) + 'px';
      box.style.height = (P.h * scale) + 'px';
      if (i < list.length - 1) box.style.marginBottom = '18px';
      var inner = document.createElement('div');
      inner.className = 'sll-paper-inner';
      inner.style.transform = 'scale(' + scale + ')';
      inner.innerHTML = html;
      box.appendChild(inner);
      wrap.appendChild(box);
    });
  }

  function syncControls() {
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-page]').forEach(function (b) { b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(b.dataset.page === settings.page)); });
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-logo]').forEach(function (b) { b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String((b.dataset.logo === 'show') === settings.logo)); });
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-foot]').forEach(function (b) { b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String((b.dataset.foot === 'show') === settings.foot)); });
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-story]').forEach(function (b) { b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String((b.dataset.story === 'show') === settings.story)); });
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-starters]').forEach(function (b) { b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String((b.dataset.starters === 'show') === settings.starters)); });
  }

  // One sheet per PDF, built the same way as the other worksheets (html2pdf, single sheet)
  function waitSheetImages(el) {
    return Promise.all(Array.prototype.slice.call(el.querySelectorAll('img')).map(function (im) {
      return im.decode ? im.decode().catch(function () {}) : Promise.resolve();
    }));
  }
  // The PDF step cannot draw inline SVG, so each figure is swapped for an image of the same size
  function svgsToImages(root) {
    root.querySelectorAll('svg').forEach(function (sv) {
      var r = sv.getBoundingClientRect();
      var clone = sv.cloneNode(true);
      clone.setAttribute('xmlns', 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg');
      clone.setAttribute('width', r.width);
      clone.setAttribute('height', r.height);
      var img = document.createElement('img');
      img.src = 'data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,' + encodeURIComponent(new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(clone));
      img.setAttribute('width', r.width);
      img.setAttribute('height', r.height);
      img.alt = '';
      img.style.display = 'block';
      sv.parentNode.replaceChild(img, sv);
    });
  }
  async function savePdf(button, sheetHtml, P, filename, check) {
    var label = button.textContent;
    button.disabled = true;
    button.textContent = 'Preparing PDF…';

    var cover = document.createElement('div');
    cover.id = 'sll-cover';
    cover.textContent = 'Preparing your PDF…';
    document.body.appendChild(cover);
    var scrollY = window.scrollY;
    window.scrollTo(0, 0);

    var holder = document.createElement('div');
    holder.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:-10000px;top:0;width:' + P.w + 'px;';
    holder.innerHTML = sheetHtml;
    document.body.appendChild(holder);
    svgsToImages(holder);
    var sheet = holder.firstElementChild;

    var opt = {
      margin: 0,
      filename: filename,
      image: { type: 'jpeg', quality: 0.98 },
      html2canvas: { scale: 2, useCORS: true, logging: false, scrollX: 0, scrollY: 0, backgroundColor: '#ffffff' },
      jsPDF: { unit: 'mm', format: P.fmt, orientation: 'portrait' }
    };

    try {
      if (check && !check(sheet)) throw new Error('too-long');
      await waitSheetImages(holder);
      await html2pdf().set(opt).from(sheet).save();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('PDF generation failed:', err);
      setNotice(err && err.message === 'too-long'
        ? 'Part 1 is too long for one page. Shorten a sentence, remove a question, or use the A4 size.'
        : 'Sorry, the PDF could not be created. Please try again.', true);
    } finally {
      holder.remove();
      cover.remove();
      window.scrollTo(0, scrollY);
      button.disabled = false;
      button.textContent = label;
    }
  }

  // Download the worksheet (page 1) or the My Story page (page 2) as its own PDF
  function exportPDF(button, part) {
    var P = PAGES[settings.page];
    if (part === 2) return savePdf(button, storyHTML(P), P, 'Plot-Mountain-My-Story.pdf');
    return savePdf(button, sheetHTML(P, title()), P, 'Plot-Mountain.pdf');
  }

  function init() {
    syncControls();
    $('sll-title').addEventListener('input', renderPreview);
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-page]').forEach(function (b) { b.addEventListener('click', function () { settings.page = b.dataset.page; syncControls(); renderPreview(); }); });
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-logo]').forEach(function (b) { b.addEventListener('click', function () { settings.logo = b.dataset.logo === 'show'; syncControls(); renderPreview(); }); });
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-foot]').forEach(function (b) { b.addEventListener('click', function () { settings.foot = b.dataset.foot === 'show'; syncControls(); renderPreview(); }); });
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-story]').forEach(function (b) { b.addEventListener('click', function () { settings.story = b.dataset.story === 'show'; syncControls(); renderPreview(); }); });
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-starters]').forEach(function (b) { b.addEventListener('click', function () { settings.starters = b.dataset.starters === 'show'; syncControls(); renderPreview(); }); });
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-start]').forEach(function (sel) { sel.addEventListener('change', function () { settings.starts[sel.dataset.start] = sel.value; renderPreview(); }); });
    $('sll-pdf').addEventListener('click', function () { exportPDF(this, 1); });
    $('sll-pdf2').addEventListener('click', function () { exportPDF(this, 2); });
    window.addEventListener('resize', renderPreview);
    renderPreview();
  }
  init();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
